raw: {"analysis":"NCS provides a clearer, more coherent migration plan with well-defined parallel lanes, explicit gates, and a practical rollback strategy that leverages the read-only legacy database. MSR introduces useful concepts like redirect rules and scope-cutting for audit deadlines, but suffers from internal inconsistencies (claiming Lane B can run parallel but then saying it must wait for Lane A) and confusing staging workflow that conflates branch merges with environment syncs. NCS also better addresses the search index verification requirement and provides a more realistic timeline accounting for the 4-hour staging lag.","verdict":"NCS"}
